item.name: Marks the fault as resolved. The Delphix engine will attempt to automatically detect cases where the fault has been resolved; but this is not always possible and may only occur on periodic intervals. In these cases, the user can proactively mark the fault resolved. This does not change the underlying disposition of the fault - if the problem is still present the system may immediately diagnose the same problem again. This should only be used to notify the system of resolution after the underlying problem has been resolved.
